policy: Replacement pages are discovery leads only. No record is published without an official item-level date, location, stable identifier, provenance, and freshness.

results.evidence: Official Seattle Parks page embeds the Trumba public calendar; the ICS export returned current volunteer entries with timezone, UID, title, date/time, and location. Two records published to the Seattle civic package.

Official Denver City Council access page points to Legistar; the calendar returned a non-canceled 2026-09-29 meeting with stable ID 1447175, explicit time, and City & County Building Room 391 location.
Official City of New Orleans Legistar calendar returned the 2026-09-17 City Council row with iCalendar ID 1428857/GUID, 10:03 AM time, and City Hall Council Chamber location.
Official Philadelphia Legistar calendar returned the 2026-09-24 CITY COUNCIL row with iCalendar ID 1442898/GUID, 10:00 AM time, and Room 400, City Hall location.

Official Richmond City Clerk page points to Legistar; the calendar returned the 2026-09-28 City Council row with iCalendar ID 1354767/GUID, 6:00 PM time, and Council Chamber, 2nd Floor - City Hall location.

Official Santa Fe City Clerk page links to the CivicClerk public meeting portal and a 2026 meeting-calendar PDF, but the public portal shell requires JavaScript and no item-level date/time/location payload was directly verifiable in the reachable response.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Identify the documented CivicClerk public API/ICS endpoint or a stable event page with explicit meeting fields.

results.evidence: Official Downtown Denver Partnership event detail JSON-LD returned scheduled start/end timestamps, venue address 101 W 14th Ave, Denver, and canonical event slug for Civic Center EATS 9/30/2026.

The official Town of Keystone site exposes council/agenda pages and an event-request form, but no reachable official public event feed, structured calendar, or item-level event pages were verified. A dated staff report is permit/planning guidance rather than a publishable event feed, so no event records were fabricated from it.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Obtain the Town's official event calendar export/API or a verified source-specific selector with stable event IDs, explicit dates, times, and locations; keep municipal meetings and resort/third-party programming separate.

results.evidence: Official Denver Engage public calendar HTML exposed stable activity UUIDs, explicit 2026-09-30 dates/times, and locations for West-Bar-Val-Wood Park Cleanup and Harvey Park Cleanup & Flowerbed Adoption. Two records published; entries without explicit locations or unqualified dates were excluded.

Official Portland, Maine homepage links to CivicClerk agendas/minutes and its calendar page exposes a CivicClerk-backed event path, but the public HTML response is client-rendered and the sampled event payload did not expose validated item-level date/location fields.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Identify the public CivicClerk calendar JSON/ICS endpoint or use a documented selector that returns stable event IDs, dates, times, and locations.

results.evidence: The official Seattle City Clerk page links to Legistar, whose calendar exposes stable meeting-detail and iCalendar IDs. Future rows sampled for 2026-09-29 through 2026-10-26 were explicitly marked Canceled, so no active meeting record was published.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Recheck the official Legistar calendar for a non-canceled dated meeting with a confirmed location before promotion.

results.evidence: The official DC Council RSS page exposes the Council calendar, and the public site advertises a WordPress Events REST API. A normal JSON request returned HTTP 200 with a valid events schema but zero published items in the current/future window; no record was promoted from archived or undated hearing material.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Recheck the official Events REST API or Hearing Management System when current published hearings are present, and require stable item IDs, explicit dates, times, and Wilson Building/virtual locations.

results.evidence: Official Legistar calendar returned current 2026 meeting rows with date, time, location, and stable meeting-detail IDs; two records published to the Prince George's County civic package.
HTTP 200 normal HTML page (text/html), not XML RSS/Atom; no feed items or item-level event schema were present.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Obtain a current official SF Rec & Parks RSS/ICS/JSON endpoint or add a verified event-calendar selector.

results.evidence: Official Socrata metadata exposes event_id, title, date, start_time, end_time, location_description, url, and related location table; sampled records were dated 2019-12, so the inventory does not provide fresh current records for publication.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Identify a current NYC Parks event inventory/API or verified export with recent dated records and joinable locations.

results.evidence: Operator guidance identifies a third-party Tockify calendar, but no owner-approved export/API was supplied; the old city page is not used to bypass a 403.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Obtain City of Meridian/Tockify owner permission and an official export, feed, or API.

results.evidence: The replacement is a press room; it is not treated as an event feed or RSS evidence.
results.nextAcquisitionPath: Locate an official Chicago events JSON/ICS/RSS endpoint or source-specific dated event calendar.
